'''"The Gamorrean Who Became a Fighter Pilot"''' was a story [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] told [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] as a child. It was based on the story of [[Voort saBinring]] and was intended to teach Jaina that she could become anything she wanted to when she grew up.
